formulas.ascii: r_i = w_i y_i + (1 - w_i) m_i; w_i = a_i / (a_i + m_i / b_i), 0 where the denominator is not positive; m_i = E_i / B_i; a_i = max(sum_j b_j (y_j - m_i)^2 / B_i - m_i / (B_i / n_i), 0). The neighbourhood j is row i plus its listed neighbours that are included (unmasked, finite e, finite b > 0) and whose slot has a positive weight (a zero-weight slot is not a neighbour; a slot naming row i itself is skipped); only the structure of the weights counts, each such slot once whatever its weight. E_i, B_i = sums of e and b over the n_i members. The spatial rate is m_i itself. Excluded rows are NaN.
